s5_empirical_detection_floors.verdict_statement: Measured against the real S1 screen: S1's module-p99 rule has 0/48 (0.0%) sensitivity to rank-1 additions at 0.1%-3.0% Frobenius norm, first detects at 20.0%, and does not reach 12/12 within the tested ladder (max 10/12 at 100.0% because two transformer out_proj tensors stay below their module p99 even at a 100%-norm injection). Single-channel 4-D Conv additions: the spectral rule first detects at > 100.0%; the auxiliary channel-z measure first fires at 20.0% (not part of S1's outlier decision). 1-D bias single-element additions first raise group-p99.9 outliers at 10sigma. Language token-embedding row replacements first exceed the row-norm p99 at 1.15x_median, the lexical max at 1.50x_median, and the clean NN-cosine max at cos_0.80.
